question: Do the mirror images of two strategy-zoo-v1 families that were reliably wrong-signed in both samples earn positive net returns going forward?
registration_note: Registered 2026-10-01. Both books were chosen AFTER seeing strategy-zoo-v1 (Z2 and Z4 were negative in both samples and nearly every regime), so no historical number counts as evidence; only days after the start are scored. Rules are the exact negation of the frozen zoo v1 definitions (src/orderflow_edge_lab/strategy_zoo.py), same universe and costs as multi-premia-blend-v1.

books.M2_btc_shock_reversal: negated Z2: after a BTC day above +2% hold the equal-weight alt basket (ex BTC) SHORT for the day; after one below -2% hold it LONG; else flat
books.M4_lottery_momentum: negated Z4 score: cross-sectional, long the quartile with the largest single-day return over the last 30 days, short the quartile with the smallest, 0.5 gross each side, weekly rebalance

economics.funding: MEXC realized funding charged on held weights

reporting.statistic: daily net return, Newey-West t (5 lags), max drawdown
